connector.name: ConnectWise CPQ
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for ConnectWise CPQ (Sell) - quotes, line items, customers, terms, and templates.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image connectwise-cpq-mcp:v1.0.0. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wyre-technology account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: CPQ_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: ConnectWise CPQ tenant/site access key (from the Sell URL ...home?accesskey=<this>)

env.name: CPQ_PUBLIC_KEY
env.description: ConnectWise CPQ public API key (Settings → Organization Settings → API Keys)

env.name: CPQ_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: ConnectWise CPQ private API key (shown once at creation)

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

env.name: AUTH_MODE
env.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
